'''March 2002 Wenatchee tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Wenatchee, WA on 30 March 2002. [[Dennis Jeffris]] won it. It is known from Earl Sessions's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3557">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-04-wenatchee-wa-3-30-02-clone-warsd3557/ wenatchee-wa-3-30-02-clone-wars], DeckTech (Earl "farScape1" Sessions, 4 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-04-wenatchee-wa-3-30-02-clone-warsd3557/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Wenatchee, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Dennis Jeffris]]
